svg.title: assembly-qc-processing: the ledger
svg.desc: One haplotype drawn as a bar of contigs enters at the top, passes FCS-GX, FCS-adaptor, Inspector, mito, misjoin and re-screen, and leaves at the bottom with every change recorded in a ledger and re-derived by an independent check. Identical QC tables sit left (raw) and right (processed).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
